## Downloads / 下载

Download `Enterprise-Compromise-Hunting-Atlas.html` and open it in your browser. No installation or server is required. Both demonstration GIFs are also attached.

下载 `Enterprise-Compromise-Hunting-Atlas.html`，使用浏览器打开即可离线使用，无需安装或启动服务器。附件同时提供中英文演示 GIF。
